name: Kettlebell Bent-Over Row
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell in each hand, soften your knees, and hinge forward at the hips with a flat spine.
Let both kettlebells hang straight below your shoulders with your palms facing inward.
Drive both elbows back close to your ribs to pull the kettlebells toward your hips while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower both weights smoothly back to full arm extension without losing your hinged posture.
tips: Keep your lower back flat and resist the urge to stand upright as you pull.
Pull the kettlebells back toward your hips rather than shrugging them up toward your chest.
